title: OversightProof counterparty attestation exchange envelope
description: A portable, offline-verifiable hand-off of an oversight receipt from a sender to an audience, carrying only the publishable core plus exchange metadata. Advisory evidence that a human review occurred and was shared, not a certification of the counterparty and not a compliance determination.

receipt.description: A full, publishable oversight receipt, exactly as defined by receipt.schema.json. Carried unchanged; it is the same object that already may leave the machine.

exchange.description: Metadata describing the hand-off only: who shared what, with whom, and why. Never any review content or PII.

sender.description: Opaque identifier of the party offering the envelope.

audience.description: Opaque identifier of the intended recipient.

issued_at.description: When the sender offered the envelope.

exchange_id.description: Opaque, sender-issued exchange identifier (a single safe token).

claims.description: The advisory statement embedded verbatim in every envelope (evidence a human review occurred and was shared; not a certification of the counterparty and not a compliance determination).

allowlisted_metadata.description: Allowlisted, non-PII metadata only, matching the receipt's ALLOWED_METADATA_KEYS. No decision data, reviewer identities, or review content.

publishable_core.description: The receipt's publishable core: the salted commitment, allowlisted metadata, and the advisory statement. Never the salt or the raw dossier root.

counter_signature.description: Optional recipient countersignature: a COSE Signed Statement descriptor over exactly the received publishable core (cose.build_signed_statement shape). An acknowledgement of receipt and check, not a verdict.

recipient.description: Opaque identifier of the countersigning recipient (the COSE issuer).

signed_statement_file.description: Optional relative path to the detached COSE_Sign1 bytes, when carried alongside the envelope.

statement.description: COSE Signed Statement descriptor (COSE_Sign1, RFC 9052). Carries publishable data only.

issuer.description: CWT iss claim: the countersigning recipient.

subject_salted_root_hex.description: CWT sub claim: the salted commitment being acknowledged.
